data.label: Retention team needs a churn model that beats the tenure heuristic
data.description: The save-offer budget is allocated from a tenure-bucket heuristic that scores 0.71 AUC. Retention wants a model good enough to reallocate the Q1 budget by predicted risk instead of by tenure.

data.label: Can a GBDT on behavioural features beat the tenure heuristic on unseen accounts?
data.description: Target: 90-day churn for self-serve accounts. Baseline to beat is the tenure-bucket heuristic at 0.71 AUC. 'Unseen' means accounts the model has never trained on, not merely rows it has not trained on.
data.scope: self-serve accounts, 2024-H2 event window, 90-day churn label

data.label: A GBDT over 42 behavioural features gains >= 0.05 AUC over the heuristic
data.description: Accounts contribute many event rows each, so the split must be grouped by account_id; a row-level split would let the same account appear in both train and test.
data.null_hypothesis: Delta AUC vs the tenure heuristic is <= 0.00 on held-out accounts.

data.label: Grouped splitting is required when rows share an entity key
data.fact_text: When multiple rows belong to one entity, a row-level random split places correlated rows on both sides and inflates held-out metrics. Split on the entity key instead.

data.label: GroupKFold(account_id) 5-fold CV with a frozen Q4 holdout
data.description: Split on account_id so no account crosses the boundary. Five CV folds for the variance estimate, plus 4,812 accounts frozen out entirely and scored once at the end. Heuristic scored on the identical holdout.

data.label: Grouped split manifest (account-disjoint)
data.description: Explicit account_id -> fold assignment, written before any training so the split cannot drift between runs. Verified account-disjoint: 0 accounts and 0 rows shared across train/holdout.

data.label: train_churn_gbdt.py (tracked training pipeline)
data.description: Reads the split manifest, builds the 42 behavioural features, fits LightGBM, writes metrics.json. Refuses to run if the manifest is absent.

data.label: Clean training run — account-disjoint split
data.description: 5-fold GroupKFold fit plus one scoring pass over the frozen holdout.

data.label: Holdout AUC 0.784 (+0.074 over the heuristic)
data.description: Scored on the 4,812 frozen accounts. Fold-to-fold spread is small, and the gain over the tenure heuristic is significant on a paired bootstrap.

data.label: GBDT beats the tenure heuristic by ~7 AUC points on unseen accounts
data.claim_text: On 4,812 accounts the model never saw, the GBDT reaches 0.784 AUC against the tenure heuristic's 0.710 — a 0.074 gain, 95% CI [0.762, 0.806], p = 0.0004. That clears the 0.05 AUC bar in HYP-001 and is enough to reallocate save-offer budget by predicted risk.
